data_fields.name: field_of_view
data_fields.donor_constant: 180 degrees (cone is half on each side)

data_fields.name: hearing_radius
data_fields.donor_constant: 25 plus per-creature HearingModifier, blocked by static geometry

data_fields.name: retarget_period
data_fields.donor_constant: accumulator above 5 with divisor 0.0549254 (14 fixed steps at 0.02 s)

data_fields.name: classic_flag_interval
data_fields.donor_constant: 0.0625 s accumulator (fires every 4th 0.02 s step, zeroed on fire)

data_fields.name: give_up_start
data_fields.donor_constant: 200 classic flag ticks (about 16 s at the 0.02 s step)

data_fields.name: priority_free_monster_bonus
data_fields.donor_constant: 5 points if a monster candidate has no target (monsters only)

data_fields.name: attacked_retarget_distance
data_fields.donor_constant: 2 units (retarget to attacker when current target is farther)

best_idea: A monster re-picks its target on a fixed cadence by scoring each candidate (+10 if seen, 30 minus distance clamped at zero, +5 for a free monster), and keeps a give-up countdown that refreshes on detection and drops it to idle at zero.
decision_why: The scoring and the refresh-on-detect give-up timer give Frankendom a concrete aggro and leash rule for row 4; the +5 free-target bonus applies only to monster candidates, so the MAX_ATTACKERS = 3 spread against players must be new work, and the stealth roll and physics sight are rejected.
acceptance: Server test: with hero A seen at 8 units and hero B unseen at 4 units, the monster targets A (score 32 against 26); after B hits the monster it retargets to B; after 200 undetected give-up ticks the monster returns to idle, and any detection resets the count to 200.
